name: param_extraction
content: Extract the explicit value for parameter '{parameter_name}' from the user's message.
Task: Analyze if the user EXPLICITLY mentioned a value for this parameter in their message.
"reasoning": "why this value or why not found"
- found=true ONLY if value is explicitly mentioned (e.g., "ping google.com" → target="google.com")
- found=false if value is implied, assumed, or not mentioned at all
- confidence: 0.7-0.9 for explicit mentions, 0.0 if not found
- value: the actual extracted value (string, number, etc.)

variables.name: parameter_name
variables.description: The technical name of the parameter to extract

variables.name: description
variables.description: Description of what this parameter represents
examples: The hostname or IP address to ping
Maximum time to wait for response

variables.name: user_message
variables.description: The user's original message or request
examples: check if the server is up

metadata.description: Extracts explicitly mentioned parameter values from user messages with high confidence
metadata.author: MagicianV2-ProgressiveElicitation
metadata.changelog: Initial version for Phase 2.1 LLM extraction
